evidence: Histories of the TR-707, including its Wikipedia article, name it as the drum machine on 'Move Your Body', and later interviews with Jefferson are cited for the same. We have not read a primary statement ourselves, so this stays consensus.

later.title: Move Your Body (The House Music Anthem)

trackPair.whatToListenFor: The piano gets the attention, so listen past it to the drums. They are bright, short and tidy, with none of the booming low end of an 808. That thin, clean kit is the 707.

explanation: 'Move Your Body' is remembered for its piano, but its drums came from a Roland TR-707, not the 808 or 909 that dominate the machine story. It was one of the machines Chicago producers could actually get in 1986, and this connection shows Chicago's toolkit as it really was, a mixed set of Roland boxes, rather than as later legend tidied it.
